title: ref.current and globals can't be dependencies

slides.say: Can you put location dot pathname, or ref dot current, in the dependency list? No.
These can change at any time outside React. Changing them does not trigger a re-render, so React never gets a chance to compare them.

slides.text: Reading mutable data while rendering also breaks render purity.
slides.say: And reading mutable data during rendering, which is when dependencies are computed, breaks the purity of rendering.

slides.text: External mutable value? Subscribe with useSyncExternalStore. The ref object itself is fine as a dep.
slides.say: To read an external mutable value, subscribe with use sync external store. Note the ref object itself can be a dependency. Its current property cannot.
